$comment: Inputs for /privacy-policy. Same discipline as facts.json: anything not verified is a TODO, never a guess. A privacy policy that states something untrue about where data goes is worse than one that admits a gap — it is a representation to regulators and customers. Every `TODO` string renders visibly on the page as [TO CONFIRM: …] and keeps `status.draft` meaningful. While status.draft is true the page renders noindex AND is excluded from the sitemap (astro.config.mjs) — flip one flag, both change together.

status.draftReason: Template placeholder — fill in the controller, hosting and cookie facts for the real site, then flip draft to false to publish.
status.effectiveFrom: TODO — the date this policy takes effect

controller.legalName: TODO — the legal entity that operates this site
controller.registeredAddress: TODO — full registered address (street, city, postcode). A city alone is not a contactable address.
controller.note: If the site and any app/product are operated by different entities, this page has to say so explicitly.

contact.dpo: TODO — named privacy contact (some laws, e.g. India's DPDP, require a named grievance officer)

marketingSite.what: This website and the analytics behind it
marketingSite.where: Cloudflare's global network (static files served at the edge); form submissions are processed by Google Apps Script and stored in a Google Sheet operated by us

subProcessors.$comment: GDPR Art.13 requires 'recipients or CATEGORIES of recipients'. Listing categories keeps the page truthful without pinning vendor names it would then have to keep current. Keep a real named list ready for security questionnaires, privately.

categories.what: Serves the site's pages from a global content delivery network.
Counts page views and clicks. Cookieless in the default configuration.
Stores what you type into the contact form and emails it to us so we can reply.

subProcessors.namedListNote: Kept privately, not published. Provided on request.

retention.$comment: GDPR Art.13(2)(a) allows the CRITERIA used to determine the period where a fixed period cannot be given. Replace with concrete periods once they are set.
criteria: Website analytics: kept only as long as useful for understanding demand, and deleted when it stops being.
Contact-form enquiries: kept while we are in touch and for a reasonable period after, so we have the history if you come back. Deleted on request.
Cookie consent (only if a cookie-setting vendor is enabled): 180 days, then we ask again.

cookies.name: site_consent
cookies.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or refused optional cookies. Only set at all if a cookie-setting vendor is enabled — in the default configuration this site sets no cookies whatsoever.

laws.law: GDPR / UK GDPR, where a visitor is located there

openQuestions: TODO — list the privacy questions you have not yet answered, so the page's gaps are deliberate and visible to you rather than silent.
